0. FOREWORD
0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part 1 ) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on 25 April 1988, after the draft finalized by the Connectors for Electronic Equipment Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council.

0.2 This standard ( Part 1 ) is one of the series of Indian Standards on radio frequency connectors for frequencies above 3 MHz, used in electronic equipment, and shall be read in conjunction with IS : 5054-1988". 0.3 This standard ( Part 1 ) is the sectional specification covering N series of connectors. Subsequent parts OF this standard would cover *General requirements and methods of tests for radio frequency connectors above 3 MHZ ( secondicitfsfaff ).

this standard, assistance has been derived from JSS 52402`Detail specification for connectors, radio frequency, series N', issued by the Directorate of Standardization, Ministry of Defence, India. 0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test shall be rounded with IS : 2-1960*. The Off in accordance number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard specifies the test schedule and requirements applicable for radio frequency connectors of N series.

c) A number denoting the type of connector, and d) A two digit numerical block, numbers varying from 01 to 99 for each type of connector to represent variants like materials, finishes, cables, cable terminating technique, applications, etc. This block is further subdivided into two blocks, one block between numbers 01 and 49 to identify connectors for professional applications and the other block of numbers between 50 and 99 to fdentlfy connectors for consumer applications. 4.2 The type designation shall be given in accord_ ante with 4.1, for example: XXXX 1s where XXXX = the reference standard, IS = Indian Standard, YY = denotes the type of connector, 1 and number of this YY - ZZ

TESTS 9.1 General - The test schedule specifies the tests and the order in which they shall be carried out as well as the requirements to be met. 9.2 Conditions of Tests - The provisions of IS : 5054-1988* shall apply. 9.3 Classification of Tests - The of IS : 5054-1988* shall apply. 9.4 Test Schedule 9.4.1 Type Tests - The test schedule for type tests and the sequence of tests shall be as specified in Table 1. The manufacturers shall submit 22 mating pairs of each style for which approval is desired. If approval is desired for all types covered in any particutar category, the manufacturer shall submit 5 mating pairs in each of the remaining types of the particular category. The additional samples shall be subjected to Group 5 tests only. *General requirements and methods of tests for radio frequency connectors above 3 MHz ( second revision ). of 8

4.3 The type designations shall be specified in the relevant detail specification. 5. MARKING 5.1 The connectors shall be marked in accordance with 6 of IS : 5054-1988*. 6. PACKAGING 6.1 The connector shall be suitably packaged to withstand normal handling and transit hazards. 6.2 Packaging ( presentation, identification and packaging ) shall be in accordance with the terms of contract. 7.
